paragraphs: Kando is described on its own site as a wastewater intelligence company that applies artificial intelligence and data analytics to the wastewater ecosystem. The site presents the offering as a wastewater intelligence platform that combines hardware, software, and expert services and is reached through a voice assistant. Kando states that the platform uses IoT devices, AI, and LLM to identify upstream wastewater quality discharges and to protect WWTP processes.

A further component named on the homepage is an Assessment map, presented as a way to prioritize daily operations, pre-treatment activities, and strategic objectives. The clients page names El Paso Water, the Metropolitan Sewer District of Greater Cincinnati, and the City of Phoenix Water Services Department. Comments on that page also come from Northern Ireland Water and from a local service manager at VEOLIA EAU.

The case study page lists a piece on supporting direct potable reuse in Texas and a Kando Pulse case study on dairy processing effluent monitoring. A separate El Paso case study is framed around improving wastewater quality and reducing OPEX.

quote.text: Our Mission: Collaborating to protect and improve the quality of the world’s most precious resource – water.
